name: livetex
description: Overleaf-style live LaTeX preview inside VS Code / Cursor: compiles as you type with Tectonic, renders the PDF next to your editor, SyncTeX in both directions, one-click PDF export, and two-way sync with Overleaf projects over Git.

commands.title: Use This File as Root Document

markdownEnumDescriptions: Use an installed TeX distribution (TeX Live, TinyTeX, MacTeX, MiKTeX) via `latexmk` if one is found — same behaviour as Overleaf (pdfLaTeX, biber). Otherwise use Tectonic.
Always use Tectonic (self-contained XeTeX engine, downloads packages on demand, no install needed).
Always use `latexmk` from an installed TeX distribution.

livetex.tectonicPath.description: Absolute path to a tectonic executable. Leave empty to auto-detect.

livetex.texBinPath.markdownDescription: Directory with `latexmk`/`pdflatex`/`biber` of your TeX distribution, e.g. `~/.TinyTeX/bin/x86_64-linux`. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH, TinyTeX, `/usr/local/texlive/*`, MacTeX, MiKTeX).

livetex.latexmkArgs.markdownDescription: Default arguments for latexmk (engine = latexmk). A `latexmkrc` in the project overrides them, and a `% !TEX program = xelatex|lualatex|pdflatex` comment in the root document overrides both. `-outdir`/`-auxdir` are added automatically.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Recompile while you type (unsaved buffers are compiled from a shadow copy; your files are never touched).
Recompile when a file is saved.
livetex.compileOn.description: When the open preview is refreshed.

livetex.debounceMs.description: Delay after the last keystroke before recompiling (compileOn = change).

livetex.fastPreview.description: While typing, run a single TeX pass that reuses the previous build's .aux/.bbl instead of the full rerun logic (Tectonic: about 2x faster; latexmk: skips latexmk's dependency analysis and extra passes). Saves, opening the preview and Compile Now always do a full build.

livetex.previewImageOptimization.description: For live-preview builds, use cached copies of large transparent PNGs flattened onto white. TeX otherwise re-encodes them on every compile (often most of the build time). Saved, manually compiled and exported PDFs always use the original images.

livetex.continueOnErrors.description: Produce a PDF even if TeX reports errors (like Overleaf). Errors still show in the Problems panel.

livetex.pdfOnSave.description: When a saved (clean) build succeeds, write <root>.pdf next to the root .tex file.

livetex.syncOnCursorMove.description: Highlight (and scroll to, if off-screen) the PDF location of the editor cursor.

livetex.shellEscape.description: Allow \write18 / shell escape (needed by minted). Only enable for documents you trust.

livetex.rootFile.description: Workspace-relative path of the root document. Leave empty to detect it (% !TEX root magic comment, \documentclass, or a file that \input's the current one).

livetex.invertPdfInDarkTheme.description: Render PDF pages with inverted colours when a dark theme is active.

livetex.overleaf.autoPull.markdownDescription: For folders linked to Overleaf (Git integration): download Overleaf changes when the editor gains focus, at most every 2 minutes. Only fast-forwards; skipped while you have unsaved edits or local changes that would be touched. Never uploads.

livetex.overleaf.pushOnSave.markdownDescription: For folders linked to Overleaf: sync (commit, merge Overleaf's changes, upload) 15 s after the last save. Off by default: use the **Overleaf** status bar item or **LiveTex: Sync with Overleaf**.
